banned_regex: \b(?:Active protagonist|Concrete want|Opposition that can win|Built-in conflict|A choice at the end|Irony or hook|Sustains the length|Distinct)\b[\s*_:|—–(\[-]*(?:weak|fail)\b
brief: Workshop this spark into one logline with the recipe (protagonist, want, obstacle, stakes), written so it passes the stress tests. Then report all eight stress tests on it, one line each in the form Test: pass, weak, or fail, and one sentence of why: Active protagonist, Concrete want, Opposition that can win, Built-in conflict, A choice at the end, Irony or hook, Sustains the length, Distinct. Judge the length test for a novel. Keep only the canon the user fixed: name no new characters, and do not decide who left the key or what the chest holds. Under 200 words, no preamble.
name: premise-logline
